_comment: Authoritative comparator registry (R-PIPE-2). Values are RESOLVED FROM THE ARTIFACT at check time; this file stores addresses, never numbers, so it cannot drift from the artifact. Any stated delta must reference an id here.

comparators.note: Maximum of the published GLM-5.3 decode curve (seq64/graph256, spliced C1-C24 from seq32/graph128). Last modified 2026-09-02.
Source series is seq32-graph128-prefill-formal. NOT comparable to seq64+ deployments, and not to prefix-cached synthetic-prompt runs. Do not use for prefill deltas on other profiles.
Four TP2 replicas behind HAProxy leastconn.

Formal campaign 20260907: seq128 / cudagraph 512 / MTP-3 / GMU 0.95, one TP8 replica, no load balancer. Median of 5 repetitions. Realized measurement window 87.8 s (declared 60 s); prompt-cache reads measured 0.0% for Decode; KV occupancy peaked at 17.1% with 0 preemptions and 0 waiting requests at this point.

FLOOR, NOT PEAK. The maximum lands on C192, the top of the frozen grid, with no measured point beyond it, so R-06-1 (Peaks) forbids treating it as a peak and acceptance.json records claim_allowed=false. 81.4% of prompt tokens at this point were prefix-cache reads, and the engine averaged 96.8 waiting requests, so this figure is cache-served throughput at a saturated queue. Never use it as a cold-prefill comparator.
Maximum of the published xe7740 decode curve: 4x TP2 replicas behind HAProxy leastconn, 8-in/512-out request shape. Repeated qualification evidence (48 runs, 3 repetitions).

xe7740 decode series point at C32 (decode-optimized series). Request shape 8-in/512-out; a same-concurrency comparison against a campaign with a different request shape must disclose the shape difference.

Maximum of the published xe7740 uncached-prefill curve (prefill-optimized-uncached series, 4096-in/8-out request shape). Repeated qualification evidence. NOT comparable to prefix-cached or different-shape prefill runs without disclosure.
xe7740 prefill series point at C32 (prefill-optimized-uncached series). Request shape 4096-in/8-out; use only with shape disclosure against other campaigns' prefill points.
